% revtex4-2's showkeys and showpacs options with keywords and no PACS
% numbers: the keywords show under the abstract, as in the PDF, and no
% PACS line does.
\documentclass[aps,showkeys,showpacs]{revtex4-2}
\begin{document}
\title{Revhead keys}
\author{Someone}
\begin{abstract}
Text of the abstract.
\end{abstract}
\keywords{first keyword, second keyword}
\maketitle
Text of the body.
\end{document}
